body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> TDK Life on Record introduced high fidelity headphone 'ST800' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

The TDK Life on Record High Fidelity Headphones deliver a truly personal listening experience. On-ear volume and mute controls give you the ability to dynamically control the audio output while high performance 50mm drivers ensure amazing sound clarity and range.

An in-line equalizer integrated into the cable delivers a stunning music visual while giving you the ability to adjust bass/treble levels to your preference. Superior materials and craftsmanship make these headphones look as good as they sound.
Tuned by our Audio Research Lab to deliver an authentic sound, from extended bass through the mid range, to enhanced treble. Listen to music the way it was intended.
Includes: Headphones with inline equalizer on cord, 12ft extension cable, 3.5mm to 6.3mm adaptor, storage pouch, (2) AAA batteries.
